printed_form_readers.rule: no_printed_readers: a later cell of the same notebook and configuration that reads a DIFF output of a printed-form cell counts as clean@E2 (as if that container agreed at E2) when every other input agrees at E2 or finer; it keeps its own class, and its kind becomes introduced if that class is coarser than E2 (cascades and harness outcomes keep their kind); no_printed leaves these cells outside clean@E2 (their clean level is DIFF)

decision_order: 2 an engine against its own replicate: nondeterminism (UNCOMPARABLE: harness)
4 ERR with NameError or UnboundLocalError: cascade (undefined name)
6 class not coarser than the clean level: inherited (propagated)
7 curated table (21 cells): introduced, curated cause
8 cause rules in order, first match wins: introduced, rule cause
9 EXCEPTION (enabled in every published count): no curated entry and no rule matched, class DIFF, clean level E1 or E4: inherited (cause order_propagated)

cause_rules.description: chained assignment / inplace-on-selection in the cell or a called function
missing mask differs after astype(str) / str accessor
error message mentions the string dtype
read_csv cell, missing mask differs (input columns hold the string 'None')
df.loc[:, col] = ... and object vs datetime dtype
groupby reduction without numeric_only, shape differs
Dask 'Mismatched dtypes' / Modin mixed str/obj encoding
quantile/percentile/describe in cell or called function
Modin pivot_table/value_counts DIFF, Bodo stale head()
describe() of datetime/timedelta columns: mean at us instead of ns (inspected: yuliagm c8, xokent c5)
unique() returns ArrowStringArray (dtype str) instead of an object ndarray
E1, or order-sensitive op (value_counts/sort/nlargest) with label/value mismatch at E3/E4
merge result order differs and head()/[:n] shows different rows
E2 reached, E0 fails on values only
arrow dtype in E0 failing check
engine CRASH/TIMEOUT cell with clean inputs
error message names an Arrow type, pd.NA, or str.extract's named-group requirement for Arrow strings
dtype=='object' / include or exclude 'O' / dtype in [numpy dtype names] on Arrow-backed columns
row count of a != filter differs on Arrow-backed data
read_csv cell; values first differ at a multiple of 4096 rows
.dtypes listing / str() / unique() of Arrow-backed columns (values differ only in their dtype text or array type)
E2; E0 fails on scalar type int vs numpy.int64
E0 fails on a NumPy/nullable dtype or array type only

replicate_stability.definition: cells of each named cause (conf_1x, and the single-rater cells) that lie in the 10 pilot notebooks of an engine with a replicate (Modin, FireDucks, Bodo, Dask), and those of them whose outputs differ between the engine's two pilot runs (taxonomy cause nondeterminism) or were lost to capture in one of them (capture_cap)
